historical_sanity_anchor.baseline: Historical Mobile Fleet shifted from Lingga to Tawi Tawi beginning 11-12 May; Taiho arrived 15 May. Historical Tawi Tawi training was increasingly constrained by US submarines.

branch_execution.11_14May: Five-deck core and major surface screen shift from the existing Davao-Celebes-Tarakan training/fuel axis into a distributed Sulu Sea reaction posture. The branch does NOT concentrate every high-value hull permanently in one Tawi Tawi anchorage.
branch_execution.basing_geometry: Tawi Tawi/Basilan-Sulu Sea with Davao/Tarakan/Borneo support retained; stagger anchor, fueling and flight-training groups to reduce submarine target density and preserve access to southern fuel.
branch_execution.five_deck_core: Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu/Soryu/Taiho reach the forward reaction system without combat loss.
branch_execution.surface_screen: Tone/Chikuma and high-quality cruiser/DD screen remain Mobile-Fleet assets. Heavy surface reserve can use the same southern support system but is not welded to carrier formation at all times.

carrier_air_18May.Taiho_integration_class: A- for one-cycle fleet work; still slightly behind established core in damaged-deck/night/adverse-weather recovery and repeated-cycle resilience
carrier_air_18May.training_effect: Forward movement interrupts some deck training days, but distributed local sorties resume. Improved ASW coverage prevents a historical-scale near-total curtailment of flying in this first week.

ASW_submarine_interaction.priority: Sulu/Tawi approaches become a top-tier protected lane because the carrier force itself is present.
ASW_submarine_interaction.Tokai_MAD_and_search_allocation: Allocate a bounded 6-10 Tokai/MAD-capable aircraft plus conventional search/escort aviation and DD/kaibokan patrols to approach/datum response; do not treat MAD as broad-ocean search.
ASW_submarine_interaction.historical_Inazuma_guard: Do not automatically inherit the historical 14-May destroyer loss. Branch convoy routes, escorts and layered ASW are different. A US submarine obtains intermittent attack opportunities but no confirmed Japanese major warship or oiler sinking is credited in 11-18 May.
ASW_submarine_interaction.US_submarine_effect: Still strategically serious: forces zigzag, escort expenditure, local no-fly/launch restrictions after sightings, and some training-day loss. It does not make the anchorage safe.

Yamamoto_decision: FORWARD_REACTION_POSTURE_GO; OFFENSIVE_HUNT_NO-GO. Use the shorter Marianas/Philippines reaction geometry while preserving the five-deck cadre and continuing ISR/submarine warning work.
